```artifact
Feature: Alarm Management

  Scenario: The GUI has a control for setting the LOW VTI threshold (RW-SW-38)
    Given the GUI is displayed
    Then the LOW VTI threshold control is visible

  Scenario Outline: Setting LOW VTI threshold within allowed range (RW-SW-40)
    Given the LOW VTI threshold control is set to <threshold_value>
    Then the threshold is set to <threshold_value>

    Examples:
      | threshold_value                     | expected_result |
      | a value within the allowed range    | success         |
      | the minimum allowed value           | success         |
      | the maximum allowed value           | success         |
      | a value below the minimum allowed   | error           |
      | a value above the maximum allowed   | error           |
      | a non-numeric value                 | error           |

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm is active when VTI exceeds threshold (RW-SW-37)
    Given the LOW VTI threshold is set to a value
    And the current breath VTI is set to a value greater than the threshold
    Then the LOW VTI alarm is active

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm has medium priority (RW-SW-79)
    Given the LOW VTI alarm is active
    Then the LOW VTI alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm is active when VTI exceeds threshold (RW-SW-163)
    Given the HIGH VTI threshold is set to a value
    And the current breath VTI is set to a value greater than the threshold
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm is active

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm has medium priority (RW-SW-164)
    Given the HIGH VTI alarm is active
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm is active when VTE exceeds threshold (RW-SW-14)
    Given the LOW VTE threshold is set to a value
    And the current breath VTE is set to a value greater than the threshold
    Then the LOW VTE alarm is active
```
